name: GoServe 2.3 • auth/reset-email
title: Reset your password
body: Enter the email address you use for your account.
annotation: UI preview only; no email is sent. Native: require a nonblank, valid email before a recovery request; preserve the entered address and avoid account-enumerating responses. Google-only users can return to Google sign-in. A demonstration address such as demo.com is not assumed to have a working inbox; email-link recovery needs an approved delivery-capable test setup. Sending advances only to the busy preview, never a fabricated delivery or success.

name: GoServe 2.3 • auth/reset-password
title: Choose a new password
body: Enter the same new password in both fields.

items.label: Password
items.helper: At least 6 characters, including a letter, a number, and a symbol.

annotation: Valid-recovery-context form preview. Native: require a provider-verified, current recovery context before opening or saving; a public app route alone is insufficient. Validate at least 6 total characters, at least one letter, one number and one symbol, plus matching nonblank confirmation. Keep passwords masked and transient; never log or persist plaintext. Save may enter busy only after validation, not success. Figma performs no token verification or password operation.

name: GoServe 2.3 • auth/reset-saving
title: Updating password…
body: Wait while your password update is checked.
annotation: Busy-state preview only. No timed success, provider operation or automatic reset-complete route. Native: submit once only after a valid recovery context, matching confirmation and the confirmed password rule; prevent duplicate saves. Do not clear the busy state into success until the server confirms the update. Back must not claim that an in-flight update was cancelled; reconcile uncertain results, clear transient secrets and retain no plaintext password. Review-index links expose independent outcome fixtures.

name: GoServe 2.3 • auth/reset-link-expired
title: Reset link unavailable
body: This link is no longer valid. Request a new reset link to continue.
annotation: Expired/invalid/already-used recovery-context fixture. Native: reject an unusable provider-verified recovery context without exposing account details; remove update authority and route to a fresh email request. Do not invent a link lifetime, regenerate a token locally or allow the new-password form without verification. No actual token is supplied or validated in Figma.
